description: dcbor plan digests, owner-signed stored plans and the Cedar flow policy (spec 0013, SDG-L3). Real Ed25519 signatures over dcbor with the RFC 8032 test keys; generated by tools/gen_dcbor_vectors.py.

vectors.note: bad-signature: goal changed and plan_digest recomputed after signing; only the signature fails
bad-signature: signed by the Core key, owner member still the owner
catalog-mismatch: message.send gained an effect; plan still verifies
bad-signature: self-consistent owner/kid/signer = Core DID; configured owner key is rfc8032-test-3
owner permit is for another destination
R10 secrets rule: matching owner permit, no forbid, still refused
forbid overrides a matching permit on a non-secrets class
R8: one request per egress step; send1 allowed, send2 refused
dot boundary: health.recordsx is not sensitive (plan.rs)
